articleTitle: Unstructured Information Attribute Extraction Algorithm Based on Time Series and Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: In order to automatically identify and extract valuable attribute information from a large amount of unstructured text data for further analysis, management, and utilization, a time series and deep convolutional neural network-based unstructured information attribute extraction algorithm is proposed. Taking enterprise union information as an example, a retrieval model for enterprise union information is constructed to retrieve enterprise union information. Convolutional neural network learning method is used to comprehensively extract the features of enterprise union information. Using time series methods to extract time related data from the characteristics of enterprise trade union information, and standardizing it into a unified date format, in order to better understand the internal structure of the data. By utilizing the powerful feature extraction capability of deep CNN, high-level attribute information closely related to time series features can be further extracted from preprocessed data through time series analysis, in order to more accurately capture key elements in enterprise union information. The experimental results show that the information attribute recommendation results of the proposed method are more accurate and efficient.

articleTitle: Data security interactive access control for the entire power grid process based on improved ASE algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a secure interactive access control method for the entire process of power grid data based on adaptive integrated online extreme learning machine algorithm. This method integrates online extreme learning machines to detect and recognize abnormal behaviors in the process of power grid data interaction, effectively ensuring the secure interaction of power grid data. The application of adaptive integration strategy further improves the accuracy and robustness of the algorithm. By real-time learning and prediction of power grid data, a dynamic behavior model of power grid data is constructed, which enables real-time monitoring and anomaly detection of data interaction behavior and adapts to the data security requirements in different power grid environments. The experimental results show that this method has significant advantages in the access control of secure data exchange in the entire power grid process. It not only improves the security of power grid data exchange, but also enhances the stability and reliability of the power grid system, providing strong guarantees for the safe and stable operation of the power grid.

Author Keywords: Adaptive ensemble online extreme learning machine algorithm
Data of the entire power grid process

articleTitle: Integrated sensing and communication toward 6G: research progress and trends
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: The integration of sensing and communication(ISAC) has become one the potential key technologies of the sixth generation mobile communications system(6G) which realizes the coordination between communication and sensing functions based on software and hardware resource sharing or information sharing. This paper reviews part of the litterateurs on ISAC, summarizes the research achievements in the key research directions of performance metric, waveform design, Multi-Input Multi-Output(MIMO), and finally analyzes the future development tendencies and challenge of ISAC.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Prediction Method Based on the Fusion of Mathematical Statistics and Failure Physics
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: A reliability prediction method combining mathematical statistics and failure physics is proposed to address issues such as poor implementation and unsatisfactory results in reliability prediction. The failure rate of non critical parts is obtained through a manual based reliability prediction method, and the life of critical parts is obtained through a failure physics based reliability evaluation method. The life is converted into a failure rate, and the two analysis methods are combined to obtain the predicted results. This method is applied to the failure rate analysis of a certain type of circuit board. The reliability prediction result based on the manual is 56.2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>/h, the reliability prediction life based on failure physics is 67322 h, and the equivalent failure rate is 10.3 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>/h. By integrating the results of the two methods, the failure rate of the circuit board is obtained as 66.5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>/h. The results indicate that this method can improve the accuracy of prediction results and identify weak links in product design, effectively guiding product design improvement.

articleTitle: A Method of SQL Injection Attack Detection Based on Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: SQL injection attacks are a serious threat to the security of cyberspace. In view of the problems with traditional SQL injection attack detection methods, such as high false positive rates and insufficient generalization, this paper proposes a new detection method based on large language models (LLMs). Through prompt engineering and instruction tuning technologies, a dedicated large language model for SQL injection attack detection is constructed. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves an accuracy of 99.85% and a false positive rate of 0.26% on general benchmark datasets, which verifies the effectiveness of large language models in the field of SQL injection attack detection.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Freshness of Frozen Yellow Croaker Based on PCL Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: This study proposes a PSO-CNN-LSTM model to address the challenge of predicting freshness during the storage of frozen yellow croaker. Firstly, the data information of volatile gases related to the preservation process of large yellow croaker was recorded through sensors. Then, the collected dataset was strictly preprocessed to effectively eliminate the negative impact of abnormal data on prediction performance, ensuring that the data is suitable for subsequent neural network model inputs; To address the issue of limited data on volatile base nitrogen, polynomial fitting is used to make the data distribution smoother and improve the prediction accuracy of subsequent neural network models; Finally, a PCL neural network is created, and convolutional neural networks are introduced to improve feature extraction capabilities. Long short-term memory networks are then used for prediction, and the best hyperparameters of the model are obtained through PSO algorithm to achieve high-precision prediction of the freshness of frozen yellow croaker. After a series of experiments, it has been verified that the PCL model performs better than traditional deep learning models in multiple evaluation metrics, including convolutional neural networks and gated recurrent units. This not only proves the effectiveness of the PCL model in predicting the freshness of yellow croaker, but also highlights its enormous potential in practical applications.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of Innovation Ecosystems in the SSCI Database (2006-2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: The conceptual framework of innovation systems has undergone a significant evolution, transitioning from the 1.0 linear innovation paradigm characterized by closed innovation, through the 2.0 innovation system paradigm marked by open innovation, to the 3.0 innovation ecosystem paradigm that emphasizes embedded and symbiotic innovation. Consequently, the innovation ecosystem has emerged as a pivotal focus and a trending topic within both the theory and practice of innovation. This paper employs a bibliometric analysis to delve into 1066 articles on innovation ecosystems indexed in the SSCI database from 2006 to September 30, 2024. Utilizing HistCite and Citespace software, the study aims to uncover the research landscape, identify prevailing research topics, and predict developmental trends within the domain of innovation ecosystems. Our findings offer a quantitative lens through which to assess the evolution of innovation ecosystems and provide strategic direction for future research endeavors aimed at fostering the continued growth and practical application of innovation ecosystem theories.

articleTitle: A visual analysis of the status quo of college Chinese research based on CiteSpace-- Take CNKI database as an example
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: With the development of society and the deepening of educational reform, the study of college Chinese has attracted more and more attention. Based on the theory of bibliometrics and CiteSpace software, this paper makes a visual analysis of relevant literatures in CNKI database, aiming to reveal the status quo and development trend of college Chinese research. Through the collation and analysis of literature data, this paper discusses the research hotspot of keyword co-occurrence, the author of the article, the keyword timeline map and so on. The knowledge map of keyword co-occurrence and the time line map of research frontier are also drawn. The results show that the study of college Chinese mainly focuses on the topics of literary literacy, cross-cultural communication and language education, and these topics are constantly evolving with the passage of time. Leading academics and research institutions have played a key role in advancing this field. At the same time, the co-occurrence analysis of key words shows the intersectionality and diversity of research fields, which reflects the important role of college Chinese in cultivating students' comprehensive quality. The purpose is to provide reference for the future research on college Chinese through the analysis of the current research status.

articleTitle: Fatigue Detection Method for UAV Remote Pilot based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of drones, fatigue detection among UAV operators has become particularly significant. To ensure the safety of drone flights, a fatigue detection method for UAV operators based on YOLOv8 is proposed. The YOLOv8 object detection algorithm is utilized for accurate detection of key features in the eyes and mouth. Detected eye and mouth features are then used to classify and assess the fatigue state of the operator. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of this method in detecting the fatigue state of UAV operators, showcasing a high level of accuracy.

articleTitle: Data Security and Privacy Protection in the Era of Big Data: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: In the era of big data, people's lifestyles are closely related to big data. With the continuous development of big data technology, people's lifestyles have undergone earth shattering changes, all of which are closely related to big data. Although the development of big data has to some extent improved people's living standards, this technology has also led to the leakage of personal information to a certain extent. This article analyzes some commonly used strategies for data security and privacy protection starting from big data, and puts forward some suggestions for data security and privacy protection.

articleTitle: Application and evaluation of RAG technology in civil aviation policy question answering
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Civil aviation policies are crucial for practitioners, but the current method of manually searching for relevant policies is cumbersome and inefficient. Existing question-answering systems based on knowledge graphs or large language models are not ideal due to the lack of high-quality policy question-answering datasets and the inability to update in real-time. To this end, this paper builds a civil aviation policy question-answering system based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The system obtains civil aviation policy-related knowledge from multiple data sources and segments it, uses ZhipuEmbedding-3 and Chroma to create a civil aviation policy text block vector library, combines vector retrieval technology to complete the retrieval of Query text blocks, obtains the context most relevant to the Query, and then combines the prompt word function of the large language model to integrate the Query and context information in real time to generate accurate answers. Finally, we use the Ragas evaluation framework to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the system. The results show that Qwen-max has the best overall performance in the indicators related to Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, and Context Recall, which are 0.89, 0.75, and 0.90, respectively. The reliability and effectiveness of the system have been verified.

articleTitle: Super-resolution reconstruction of infrared images based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Due to the technical limitations of devices and processes, the resolution of infrared images is relatively low compared with that of visible light images, and there are shortcomings such as blurred detailed texture features. In this paper, a super-resolution method for infrared images is proposed based on convolutional neural network. The method consists of a two-branch infrared image information extraction module by combining dense connections and the multi-scale attention residual block proposed in this paper, and the module is used to construct an infrared image super-resolution network. Experimental results show that the infrared images reconstructed by this paper's method outperform the SRCNN, EDSR, RDN, and MFDRN super-resolution reconstruction models based on deep learning in terms of peak signal-to-noise ratio. The average PSNR of the reconstructed images is improved by 2.27 dB and 2.14 dB over the traditional Bicubic interpolation method at scale factors of x2 and x4, respectively.

articleTitle: A study on news headline classification based on BERT-CNN-LSTM model with fusion adversarial training
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Due to the high complexity of the BERT model, it is prone to overfitting on small datasets, and short texts usually contain limited sentiment information, which makes them susceptible to noise interference during training. To address these issues, we propose a text categorization model that integrates adversarial training with BERT-CNN-LSTM. First, we incorporate adversarial training techniques into the BERT model, using adversarial samples as inputs. The encoded outputs from the pre-trained BERT model are then used as inputs for both the CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) models. Finally, we fuse the outputs from the CNN and LSTM and produce classification results through a fully connected layer. We also conducted experimental comparisons with models such as BERT, BERT-CNN and BERT-DPCNN, and the results demonstrate that our proposed model exhibits superior generalization ability in short text classification.

articleTitle: An Attention-Based Approach to Client-Selected Federated Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of data analytics and cloud computing, how to enhance the efficiency of data processing while protecting user privacy has become a key challenge. This study proposes a novel privacy-enhanced lossless federated corecommendation framework (AttFedRec++), which integrates the attention mechanism with homomorphic encryption. By adaptively evaluating the dynamics of the task and the current state of the client, AttFedRec++ is able to optimize the resource allocation in federated learning, thus improving the computational efficiency. Meanwhile, this framework adopts Paillier-DJN homomorphic encryption scheme to ensure the security of data during communication. Experimental results on the standard dataset MovieLens show that AttFedRec++ can effectively accelerate the convergence speed of the model without sacrificing the recommendation accuracy.

articleTitle: Intelligent warning of spare parts inventory safety based on cloud computing and ID3 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Considering the discontinuous and uncertain demand for spare parts, as well as the wide variety and slow turnover of spare parts, which makes it difficult to accurately predict inventory demand, in order to optimize spare parts inventory management, ensure the safety and timeliness of spare parts supply, reduce inventory costs, and improve overall operational efficiency, a cloud computing and ID3 algorithm based intelligent warning method for spare parts inventory safety is proposed. Build a cloud based spare parts inventory management platform to meet the need for real-time sharing of spare parts inventory information. Collect data related to safety stock through the platform, use ID3 algorithm to predict safety stock level, and set the predicted safety stock level as the warning threshold. When the inventory level approaches the safety stock threshold, the system triggers the warning mechanism. The experimental results show that the proposed method has a low out of stock rate, high inventory turnover rate and inventory cost reduction rate, indicating that it effectively improves inventory structure and reduces inventory costs.

articleTitle: AutoCross: Automatic Feature Interaction Learning with Self-Attention Neural Networks Integrating Feature Graph Information
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Credit default prediction is a crucial task for forecasting whether borrowers will default, providing accurate and efficient decision-making information for bank credit departments. However, this task is challenging for two main reasons. First, the input features are often sparse and high-dimensional, requiring effective methods to extract meaningful information from them. Second, the high-order combinatorial features on which default prediction depends are typically handcrafted by experts, a process that is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and difficult to enumerate all possible feature combinations. Therefore, automatically learning high-order combinatorial features can reduce the cost of feature engineering and improve the predictive performance of the model. In this study, we propose a module called Feature Relationship Fusion Attention (FRFA), which learns the relationships between features and integrates these relationships into the attention calculation to enhance the model's ability to capture high-order combinatorial features. Based on the proposed FRFA module, we introduce a model specifically designed for credit default prediction, called AutoCross, which efficiently learns high-order combinatorial features automatically by integrating the node position information and node importance information from the fused feature relationship graph into the attention mechanism. In summary, this model fits large-scale data through an end-to-end approach, leveraging the AutoCross model to automatically learn high-order feature interactions, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of credit default prediction.

articleTitle: Study on Deep Learning-Based Multimodal Fusion for Significant Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer vision and deep learning technologies, Salient Object Detection (SOD) has been widely applied in fields such as image understanding, video analysis, and robot vision. Traditional target detection methods mainly rely on single mode data. However, due to the diversity of image and video data, single mode has limitations in dealing with complex scenes. This article summarizes the core research achievements in this field over the past five years, and provides a detailed review of multi-modal saliency object detection tasks based on RGB-D (depth image data), RGB-T (thermal imaging data), and VDT (visual depth thermal imaging). The existing research is systematically organized, summarized, and evaluated. Finally, the article also conducted in-depth discussions and prospects on the current challenges and future development trends in this field.

articleTitle: Research on the fault detection and automatic repair method of electric power system based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: With the global industrialization and modernization, the power system has become the core part of modern social life. In this paper, RNN network model is used to build an advanced power system fault detection system, and the automatic repair strategy is realized combined with reinforcement learning. The aim is to provide a more robust, fast and adaptive fault response mechanism for the electric power system. The experiment has proved that the proposed method has made some progress in the automation and intelligent fault diagnosis and repair of the power system.

articleTitle: GraphCS: Community-Enhanced Minority Hard Point Generation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: In graph classification tasks, the issue of class imbalance may lead models to be biased toward dominant classes, thereby reducing the recognition ability for minority classes and negatively impacting overall performance. To address this issue, this study proposes a community-enhanced minority hard point generation method. The method identifies "hard point" nodes in minority classes based on community strength, expanding the decision boundary to tackle the problem of spatial compression. Furthermore, graph diffusion smoothing is utilized to convert unweighted graphs into weighted ones, preserving the neighborhood structure's integrity. A differential graph diffusion strategy is adopted to generate the diffusion matrix. Experimental results demonstrate that this method significantly enhances the classification accuracy of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for minority class nodes on datasets such as Cora and Amazon-Photo, showcasing its effectiveness in solving class imbalance problems.

articleTitle: Research on Campus Safety Risk Coupling Based on N-K Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: In order to study the coupling characteristics of campus safety risk, combined with 120 campus safety incidents in China from 2001 to 2024, the risk coupling analysis was carried out from four dimensions of personnel, management, equipment and environment, as well as three aspects of single factor, double factor and multi-factor, and the risk value of different coupling forms was calculated based on the N-K model. The results show that the more coupling risk factors occur, the more serious the risk consequences. Personnel factors and equipment factors are the main factors causing campus safety incidents, so the coupling effect of personnel and equipment factors should be avoided. Finally, this paper puts forward targeted suggestions from three aspects: controlling key risk factors, avoiding multi-risk factor coupling and managing risk sources, so as to provide theoretical reference and decision support for campus safety management.

articleTitle: Prediction of the number of flood victims based on improved gray Markov models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy in predicting the number of people affected by floods under flood disaster scenarios, the article proposes an improved gray Markov model based on the gray model using Markov theory and sparrow search algorithm. The article uses Markov theory to correct the residuals of the gray prediction model, and uses SSA algorithm to optimize the whitening coefficients of each state interval of the gray Markov model.The number of people affected by the disaster is predicted using the gray model and the gray Markov model respectively, and compared with the improved gray Markov model, and the results show that the established prediction model has a smaller error compared with the gray Markov model and the gray model, and has feasibility and practicality.

articleTitle: Survey and analysis of influencing factors of acceptance intention of carbon inclusive platform based on Technology acceptance Model-Theory of Planned Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: In recent years, all provinces and cities in China have successively issued policies to develop carbon inclusive benefits, strengthened the standardization and management of CGSP (Carbon Generalised Systems of Preferences) mechanism, and "carbon inclusion" have entered a stage of rapid development. Existing research on carbon inclusion mainly focuses on the overview and top-level design of carbon inclusion, but few studies explore the participation intention of carbon inclusion from the perspective of individuals, indicating that more in-depth and extensive research is still needed in this field. Therefore, this study is mainly designed based on the framework of TAM-TPB model, through two aspects of willingness to accept, and influencing factors, including attitude to accept, subjective norm, trust in government and perceived norm. Through the construction of structural equation model and AMOS software to explore the direct or indirect impact of each influencing factor on the willingness to accept, among which the perceived norm factor has the largest indirect impact, and the acceptance attitude factor has the largest direct impact. Based on the experimental results, starting from the 2P system of government and enterprises, this study puts forward targeted suggestions for the innovation and development of carbon inclusive platform, so as to promote the promotion of carbon inclusive platform in China.

Author Keywords: Technology acceptance Model-Theory of Planned Behavior

articleTitle: MSA-TFN: Multi-Scale Attention Two-step Fusion Network for EEG-fNIRS Motor Imagery Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Motor imagery (MI) is crucial in brain-computer interface (BCI) research and is widely applied in neurorehabilitation and prosthetic control. Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals have high temporal resolution but are susceptible to noise and have low spatial resolution. In contrast, functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) signals provide good spatial resolution but suffer from poor temporal resolution. Therefore, effectively combining the advantages of these two signals becomes a key issue in improving the performance of motor imagery classification. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a novel multi-scale attention two-step fusion network (MSA-TFN) that includes dual-path feature extraction, feature fusion, temporal modeling of fused features, and final classification. The dual-path feature extraction module captures EEG and fNIRS features independently, leveraging the advantages of both modalities. The multi-scale attention mechanism adaptively adjusts the fusion weights, and the two-step fusion strategy further enhances feature integration. Additionally, the Transformer module is introduced to capture long-range feature dependencies. This model was tested and evaluated using the publicly available TU-Berlin-A dataset, achieving an average accuracy of 83.29%, outperforming other state-of-the-art studies on the same dataset, which demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: GAN-Based Intrusion Detection System for IoT Services
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: With the great development of modern technology, the Internet of things are gradually changing the way we live. Many industry experts believe it will be the biggest technological shock since cloud computing because plenty of data can be collected, stored and analyzed than ever before. Thus, as an important technology, IoT services have been extensively used in not only our daily life but also Industry and agriculture. It is worth nothing that attackers are increasingly turning their attention to the public or personal IoT services. Hence, an effective detection scheme should be conducted as soon as possible. Generating Adversarial Network (GANs) can dispose the dataset of real life which is complex high-dimensional distribution, making it very suitable for the detection of abnormal state. However, at present, GANs commonly used for pattern recognition and speech recognition but rarely used in the field of information safety. In this paper, we used the an improved GANs model try to perform intrusion detection in IoT services. In the experiment, we improved the architecture of GANs to achieve the most advanced performance and shorten the training time when being compared with the present published other methods.

articleTitle: Concise Consortium Blockchain Consensus Algorithm with Pattern Conversion Support
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: In view of the engineering and algorithm conflicts in the application process of alliance chains, this article analyzes the threat risks faced by public and alliance chains, and summarizes their differences. By analyzing the typical alliance chain consensus algorithms of CFT and BFT, we propose a simple consensus algorithm (SCA) for blockchain. The algorithm is designed from the perspectives of participation roles, view switching, transaction consensus, and model analysis, and can achieve efficient view switching and transaction consensus through a three-part minimal structure. It can support the conversion between CFT and BFT through consensus threshold definitions, with the shortest execution period and fastest consensus efficiency. After in-depth analysis, the algorithm has a fault tolerance rate of no less than N/3, which is significantly better than the PBFT algorithm in terms of processing performance, while resisting existing threats to the consortium chain.

articleTitle: OTN Fault Localization Algorithm Based on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the telecommunications industry, the network rate interface of Optical Transport Network (OTN) can reach 400G, becoming the core backbone for carrying massive data and service signals. A single network fault, such as node or link failure, can severely threaten Quality of Service (QoS) and lead to service interruptions. Therefore, rapid and accurate fault localization and repair are crucial. To overcome the current issues faced by OTN fault localization technologies, such as low accuracy and insufficient dynamic adaptability, we propose an OTN fault localization algorithm based on graph neural networks (GNN). First, we construct an alarm knowledge graph (KG) that tightly associates complex alarm information with network device metrics. Subsequently, we utilize GNN to deeply mine potential fault patterns in the network topology, achieving intelligent localization of complex fault scenarios; to capture the causal relationships among alarms, we introduce a causal attention mechanism. Experimental results show that our proposed localization method can quickly identify root alarms during alarm storms, significantly improving the accuracy of fault localization, reducing localization time, and enhancing operational efficiency and service quality in communication networks. This research provides strong technical support for the stable operation of OTN networks and holds significant practical application value and theoretical significance.

articleTitle: Tuning of Abnormal Financial Data Alarm Model for Pharmaceutical Enterprises–Fusion Based on PSO-RF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: In order to more effectively identify the abnormal financial data of pharmaceutical enterprises and avoid financial risks, the study summarized the abnormal alarm signal indicators and behavior characteristics of listed pharmaceutical enterprises' financial data, and 1653 items were calculated based on valid financial data of 87 pharmaceutical enterprises from 2013 to 2022 in the CSMAR database. The real estate enterprises are divided into normal category (34) and abnormal category (53), and a financial data anomaly alarm model combining MinMax normalization and Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) with Random Forest (RF) algorithm (PSO-RF) is proposed. By testing and analyzing the characteristics of pharmaceutical enterprises and their financial data, the alarm index system and alarm model are screened and constructed. The research shows that: ①The alarm model constructed by the integration of MinMax normalization and PSO-RF model can identify the abnormal financial data of pharmaceutical enterprises more accurately and carefully. ②The fused alarm model outperforms the standard random forest model by 12.85%, providing more dependable application value. ③Money metrics like the Operating Profit Ratio, Fixed Asset Turnover and Net Profit Ratio have a significant role in determining abnormal alarms of financial data, and pharmaceutical enterprises should focus on such indicators. The study is expected to provide important reference for pharmaceutical enterprises and auditors to identify and discover potential financial data anomalies in time.

articleTitle: Exploring the Transformative Role of Machine Learning in Predictive Marketing: Enhancing Customer Targeting and Addressing Privacy Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is playing a transformative role in predictive marketing. This article explores the specific applications of machine learning and the challenges it presents, how it gives businesses a competitive edge in the market, and the risks they need to manage. Predictive marketing is the use of machine learning algorithms to analyze historical data, identify patterns, and predict future customer behavior. Machine learning plays an important role in predictive marketing. Marketers can develop personalized marketing strategies that anticipate customer behavior, reduce customer churn, and optimize deal pricing to gain a market advantage. However, certain applications of machine learning can also raise privacy and transparency issues. Companies need to comply with data protection regulations and prevent data breaches. At the same time, companies also need to pay attention to the accuracy of the data and prevent significant errors in the results of machine learning algorithms from causing serious harm to companies.

articleTitle: Hynobius amjiensis automatic recognition based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: Hynobius amjiensis is a critically endangered species endemic to China, classified as a national first-class protected animal. Understanding the current wild status of Hynobius amjiensis is essential for conservation and regulatory efforts. However, due to the species’ unique ecological habits, direct field tracking is challenging. This paper explores the feasibility of underwater high-definition video surveillance and deep learning to monitor Hynobius amjiensis in the field, and evaluates the impact of data sets on model accuracy. The results indicate that: (1) Variations in time periods, behavioral states, and occlusion levels of target samples significantly affect the model's detection accuracy and recall rate; (2) Incorporating samples of similar species improves the overall performance of the model, enhances species classification precision, reduces the false detection rate, and increases the model's robustness and generalization capability. The optimal model, YOLOv8x-ABCD, demonstrated superior performance across all evaluation metrics and exhibited the highest accuracy in detection results. However, non-living objects in the water, such as aquatic plants, shed egg bands, and branches, were occasionally misidentified as adult Hynobius amjiensis. Experimental results suggest that increasing the number of negative samples effectively reduces such misdetections, lowers the model’s error rate, and enhances detection accuracy and generalization.

articleTitle: Financial Data Abnormality Alerting and Empirical Research on Chinese Real Estate Enterprises - based on Information Entropy and Logistic model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: This paper summarizes the abnormal warning signal indicators of listed real estate enterprises' financial data and their behavioral characteristics. The study is based on 708 valid financial data of real estate enterprises from 2010 to 2022 in the Cathay Pacific database. The data was classified into normal (73) and abnormal real estate enterprises (121). The study screened and constructed the warning indicator system using information entropy and modeled it through Logistic regression analysis. The model passed the statistical test. The study shows that: (1)the warning model constructed by fusing information entropy and logistic regression achieves a warning accuracy of 88.70%. (2)Financial indicators such as accounts receivable turnover ratio, inventory turnover ratio, net profit margin, and return on assets play a significant role in identifying abnormal financial data effectively. Real estate enterprises should prioritize monitoring these indicators. (3)Compared with traditional financial analysis models, logistic regression analysis demonstrates higher accuracy and practical value in identifying financial anomalies of real estate enterprises. The study aims to offer a valuable reference for real estate companies and auditors to promptly identify and uncover potential financial anomaly risks.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Image Road Recognition Application Based on Improved SRCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer Network Technology and Electronic and Information Engineering (CNTEIE)
abstract: The application of drones in surveying and monitoring is becoming increasingly important, especially in road information detection. Traditional road detection algorithms have low accuracy and poor anti-interference capabilities, while deep learning methods, although superior in performance, require a large amount of labeled data and have high computational complexity, making them difficult to apply in practice. To address this, this paper proposes an improved drone image road recognition method that combines SRCNN and UNet. The paper improves SRCNN by introducing an attention mechanism to enhance feature extraction capabilities and optimizes the network structure to reduce computational complexity. The improved SRCNN generates high-resolution images as input for UNet, which is further optimized to adapt to drone images. Experimental results show that this method outperforms existing technologies in terms of accuracy, real-time performance, and robustness, meeting practical requirements. In the future, we will explore combining other sensor data and optimizing network structures to enhance road detection performance.
